decision: Bind the current scoped CQ to the exported logistics relation. Retire the old generic query as evidence for this ORSD row; preserve historical files. Do not assert owl:equivalentProperty or rename the ontology silently.
generic_requirement_status: Still requires future per-domain realization paths if scope expands

queries.corrected:
PREFIX c: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.1/> PREFIX d: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/experimental/coherence/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?cap ?org WHERE { ?cap a c:EnterpriseCapability ; c:capabilityBearer ?org . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?cap d:capabilityRealizedInLogistics ?activity } } ORDER BY ?cap ?org
